notes: Strip a: x 0-2320 plus ~300 px overlap (to 2620; the 'ST.' stub/Gilbert T at x 2628 and Alms Place crossings at x 2563-2638 sit on the overlap edge). Gilbert Avenue forms the plate's west edge (west half of the street cut by the plate edge in places; centre taken midway between the plate-edge line and the east block line, ~90 px wide), turning NE at y ~2300. N-S streets: Monfort Street (x ~1340-1355, Foraker to Yale; printed 'MONFORT' / 'ST.'; 50' north of Chapel, printed 29' and visibly narrower south of Chapel), Kemper Lane (x ~1157-1186, Yale to McMillan; printed 'LANE' at mid-length and 'KEMPER' near McMillan), Park Avenue (x ~1867-1938, Foraker to McMillan, car track down the middle; printed 'AVENUE' near Lincoln and 'PARK' near McMillan), Mentor Street (x ~2068, Churchill/Foraker north to a dead end; printed 'ST.' at the north end and 'MENTOR' near Foraker), Alms Place (x ~2563-2638, Foraker to McMillan, car track between Chapel and Yale; printed 'PL.' south of Lincoln and 'ALMS' near Locust; the stretch from Foraker to Lincoln is assumed to carry the same name), Penniston Court (x 2288, 20 ft, printed 'PENNISTON CT.'), Vail Street (x 588, 20 ft, printed 'VAIL ST.'). E-W streets: Churchill Avenue, Foraker Avenue (printed 'FORAKER' ... 'AVE.'), Lincoln Avenue, Whitlow Street, Chapel Street (printed 'CHAPEL'; no suffix seen in the strip or just east of it, 'Street' assumed), Myrtle Avenue ('MYRTLE' ... 'AVE.'), Yale Avenue, Locust Street ('LOCUST' ... 'ST.'), McMillan Street ('McMILLAN' ... 'ST.'). Lincoln and Myrtle both jog at Alms Place (recorded as two T junctions each); Foraker has a small jog at Monfort and the Park Avenue / Mentor Street pair meets Foraker ~130 px apart (two T junctions). Alms Place carries an in-street line ~25 px west of its east block line north of Chapel; centre taken between the block lines (~90 px wide). Large spaced lettering 'H E N R Y', 'W A L ... T', 'GEO. MATHER'S', 'FINKBINE', 'J. NO. LOCKWOOD SUB.', 'LANE'S', 'JACOB'S' are owner/subdivision names, not streets. The diagonal sewer line along the SE side of Mather's Est (x 2300-2800, y 1300-2200) is an easement, not a street. Stub names not printed on this plate: the '...TA' and 'WAL... S' stubs at Gilbert's bend, two 'AVE.' stubs west of Gilbert (y ~2482, ~2833), an unnamed stub west of Gilbert at y 4825, the 'ST.' stub north of Gilbert at x ~2600, and a stub south of McMillan at x ~2337.
